description.text: The promos of the XY Series, numbered XY01 to XY211 and released from October 2013 to May 2017. The set began with the Collector's Pin Three Pack Blisters, out the same day as the Pokémon X and Y games, and the prefix changed from BW to XY. Almost all came in products, above all collections, blisters, boxes, premium collections and tins, with prerelease promos and their staff copies alongside. The World Championships trophy card Champions Festival came out in 2014, 2015 and 2016, and near the end of the run came Pokémon League prizes for the Evolutions seasons of 2016-2017: a Pikachu and eight Gym Badge cards.

sources.title: Pokumon: Champion Champions Festival (XY176 English Promo)

description.text: Champions Festival was the promo card of the 2016 Pokémon World Championships, held from 19 to 21 August 2016 at the San Francisco Marriott Marquis. Competitors received the card in seven languages, staff got a Staff copy, and the top finishers in each division got copies stamped with their placement, from Top Thirty-Two up to Champion. How many trophy copies were handed out changed from year to year.
